# `quick`

Helper: `quick([icon, title, sub], ...)`  
Kit (`src/ui`): web-only (kit gap) · status: kit gap (web-only)  
App (KMP `core:ui`): `PemaActions` (core:ui), `PemaAction` (core:ui)

## Anatomy

Row of tiles; each: icon (brand-500), bold title (label), sub line (micro).

## Variants

- 2-4 tiles

## States

- Tiles are buttons in the product

## Tokens

brand-50, brand-500, brand-700, ink-soft, radius-tile

## Do

- Use for the three or four most common actions on home

## Don't

- Do not use it for navigation (menu)

## Web (1440 and 1920)

Equal columns, min height 92.

## Mobile (390)

Same as 1440; the frame is narrower, nothing is hidden.

## Rules (design-specs/web/BLOCKS.md)

Quick-action tiles in one row (home "Việc hôm nay": Chăm sóc, Ảnh tiến trình, Gửi cập nhật)
